title: Engineering MXene surfaces and heterostructure interfaces for efficient heterogeneous catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00376H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Liang Tian, Feiyan Xu, German Sastre, Ana Primo, Jiaguo Yu, Hermenegildo García
This review highlights how MXene surface and interface engineering enables atomic-scale control of terminations, defects, and interfacial fields, thereby regulating charge flow and catalytic pathways across electro-, photo-, and thermocatalysis.
